items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Deluxe Dancing Academy, Garfield Wilson's Orchestra,

ctx.x: Amateurs. Amateurs. Oh, yeah. Amateurs there. Oh, and she won Amateurs? And LaRue was managing. I'm not too sure too much about it. It's been a long time.
Well, here's something in 1915. Deluxe Dancing Academy... Well, the Deluxe happened to be across the street later on, but notice, Deluxe Dancing Academy, Garfield Wilson's Orchestra,
Dreamland Hall. That was upstairs. The Deluxe was upstairs.
